about: ERROR.TYPE (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 17; ADR-0047, 2026-10-10). Microsoft's table numbers #NULL! to #N/A from 1 to 7, and anything that is not an error is #N/A. #GETTING_DATA and #CIRC! are given back, never numbered; an Error Value outside the table is #VALUE! until a Windows run asks Excel.

cases.description: Microsoft's table: #NULL! is 1 (its example, A2 holding #NULL!)
Microsoft's table: #DIV/0! is 2
Microsoft's table: #VALUE! is 3
Microsoft's table: #REF! is 4
Microsoft's table: #NAME? is 5 (a function nobody declared)
Microsoft's table: #NUM! is 6
Microsoft's table: #N/A is 7
Microsoft's table: a number, which is no error, is #N/A
Microsoft's table: text, which is no error, is #N/A
Microsoft's example: ERROR.TYPE of #DIV/0! chooses its message with CHOOSE

cells.ZZ1000: =IF(ERROR.TYPE(A3)<3,CHOOSE(ERROR.TYPE(A3),"Ranges do not intersect","The divisor is zero"))

cases.description: Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a blank cell, which is no error, is #N/A
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a boolean, which is no error, is #N/A
Refused until Excel is asked: #SPILL! typed into a cell is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
Refused until Excel is asked: #SPILL! from a spill with an Entry in its way is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
Refused until Excel is asked: #CALC! from a FILTER that keeps nothing is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
Refused until Excel is asked: #FIELD! typed into a cell is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
Refused until Excel is asked: #BLOCKED! typed into a cell is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
Refused until Excel is asked: #CONNECT! typed into a cell is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
Refused until Excel is asked: #UNKNOWN! typed into a cell is outside Microsoft's table, so #VALUE!
ERROR.TYPE over a cycle is #CIRC!, given back rather than numbered
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047: a Formula that reads a cycle member is #CIRC!, where Excel shows 0, which is no error

cases.description: ERROR.TYPE over a range of several cells, where one Value is wanted, is refused
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0125: functions are not lifted over arrays yet; an array where the function wants one Value is #VALUE!, where Excel 365 lifts it and spills
